sanskrit_verse: दद्याद् धनं च पर्याप्तं क्षेत्रांशं वा यद् इच्छति ।।
transliteration: dadyād dhanaṃ ca paryāptaṃ kṣetrāṃśaṃ vā yad icchati
sph_interpretive_translation: One must provide sufficient wealth or a portion of land according to the desire of the one who has a rightful claim.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from legitimate claim and conscious entitlement
Causation arises from dharmic duty to fulfill rightful expectations
Capacity-based responsibility requires assessment of available resources
Restoration logic demands satisfaction of essential needs for reintegration
Consciousness alignment occurs through voluntary fulfillment of dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity possesses a legitimate dharmic claim AND the other party has sufficient capacity, THEN the latter MUST allocate adequate resource (wealth/land) accordingly.
IF allocation matches the expressed need AND aligns with dharmic entitlement, THEN completion status = TRUE; ELSE iterate until alignment achieved.
IF any agent fails to execute due to misaligned consciousness, THEN initiate pramāṇa-based realignment protocol before re-assessment.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this verse establishes that fulfillment of dharmic obligation supersedes contractual or procedural formalities when rooted in verifiable need and capacity. The court must ensure alignment between entitlement, availability, and conscious willingness to restore balance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa confirms the causal link between unmet entitlement and systemic imbalance. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how non-fulfillment disrupts sequential harmony. Proportional responsibility lies solely in restoring what is rightfully due without inflicting consequence. Reality remains non-punitive as long as restoration flows from awakened capacity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Identify precise quantum of wealth or land required for satisfaction.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Verify capacity and willingness of provider through sankalpa-aligned inquiry.
Integrity Reintegration Loop: Ensure recipient acknowledges receipt and attains closure through mutual recognition.
Consciousness Restoration Checkpoint: Monitor both parties' energetic resonance post-execution to confirm absence of residual distortion.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is executed. Wealth and land flow according to rightful desire, untainted by punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Reality abides in non-retaliation. All beings are restored unto their inherent completeness.
